cohort: 70 patients undergoing spinal anaesthesia for elective caesarean section, excluding those with emergency procedures or a history of blood pressure disorders.
finding: Co-loading is associated with less frequency of post-spinal hypotension compared to pre-loading in patients undergoing caesarean section.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken at anaesthesia induction and then at 5, 10, 15, and 30 minutes post-anaesthesia induction during caesarean section.
